title: EOD Price Production and Overnight Batch Chain
description: Versioned, immutable end-of-day closing-price production gated behind a durable event, driving one downstream position-marking consumer.

nodes.label: Ops / Admin
nodes.description: Triggers session close, resolves flagged prices via override, publishes.

nodes.label: EOD Session-Close CronJob
nodes.description: Scheduled trigger calling the same session-close endpoint an operator uses.

nodes.label: Price Publisher
nodes.description: Existing last-trade feed (pricing.*) that EOD production reads from.

nodes.label: Trade Processor
nodes.description: Hosts EOD price production: classify, version, override, publish, emit gate event.

nodes.label: MariaDB
nodes.description: Versioned closing-price snapshot tables and the consumer's P&L result table.

nodes.label: NATS JetStream
nodes.description: Durable stream carrying EOD_PRICES_READY and eod.pnl.done.

nodes.label: Position Service
nodes.description: EOD consumer: marks positions against the published snapshot version, fail-safe per account.

nodes.label: Prometheus
nodes.description: Scrapes EOD chain metrics from both services.

nodes.label: Grafana
nodes.description: EOD batch chain dashboard: published/flagged/marked/halted, chain latency.
